puntos.texto: Overshoot Day if everyone lived like Qatar

turnos.t: The ecological footprint is the area of biologically productive land and water needed to provide the resources a population consumes and to absorb its wastes, especially carbon emissions. Biocapacity is what that area can supply and absorb. Both are measured in global hectares.

Footprint bigger than biocapacity is an ecological deficit. Smaller is a reserve. A country can run a deficit by importing, depleting natural capital or accumulating waste like CO₂. But the whole world can't import from anywhere. Humanity has been in overshoot since the early 1970s.
